data.name: Neem
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘nīm’, meaning ‘twig’ or ‘shade’, the name Neem is a beautiful and evocative choice for a baby. Neem is a symbol of strength and resilience, as the tree from which it is derived is known for its ability to thrive in harsh conditions. It also carries the themes of nourishment and healing, as the tree is used for its medicinal properties in various traditional practices.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents growth, renewal, and nourishment. It is also a reminder of Allah's abundant blessings and the strength and resilience that we can find within ourselves.

data.cultural_impact: The name Neem holds a rich cultural significance in various Islamic traditions. Neem is the name of one of the 101 names of God in the Quran - Al-Nim, also known as The Possessor of the Tendrils or The Entangler. This name signifies God’s ability to extend His mercy and compassion to all of His creation, just like how the roots of the Neem tree extend wide to nourish everything around it.
data.spiritual_significance: Furthermore, the spiritual significance of the name Neem can be linked to the story of Prophet Sulaiman (Solomon) and the Queen of Sheba in Islamic tradition. It is said that Prophet Sulaiman was blessed with the knowledge of healing, and during his journey to the Queen of Sheba, he came across a tree called Neem. The tree had the power to cure all ailments, and Prophet Sulaiman used its leaves to heal the sick and the wounded. This story highlights the name Neem as a symbol of healing, compassion, and mercy. Overall, the Islamic name Neem is not only a lovely and meaningful name that carries the strength and resilience of the tree, but it is also deeply rooted in the rich Islamic tradition and spiritual significance.
